CIP transfers must follow GAAP principles and construction accounting guidelines
CIP transfers should be documented and monitored regularly
quiz.explanation: CIP transfers requires comprehensive understanding of industry standards, GAAP principles, and consistent documentation. Construction CFOs must apply all these elements to effectively manage cip transfers in their organizations.
